nodes.label: Cancel/Close Icon
nodes.description: 17x17px SVG cross/X icon drawn with two diagonal lines (stroke #EEEEEE, stroke-width 2). Created with Sketch. Used as a dismiss or close button in modal dialogs, overlays, or input fields across the app.
nodes.visual_design: Two crossing diagonal lines forming an X shape; light grey (#EEEEEE) stroke on transparent background; minimal flat style
nodes.purpose: Dismiss, cancel, or close UI elements
